title: Oryn Living Operational Graph and Knowledge Governance Wire Schemas (v1)
description: Normative Draft 2020-12 wire schemas for Oryn capabilities, playbooks, business rules, decision tables, conflicts, dependencies, guidance projections, and cross-team handoffs.

DependencyManifestV1.description: Immutable declaration of transitive knowledge dependencies. manifest_sha256 is the SHA-256 hash of RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {schema_id, organization_id, consumer_ref, dependencies, completeness, owner_component}, explicitly excluding manifest_sha256 and server-assigned registered_at. Dependencies sort lexicographically by (organization_id, entity_kind, entity_id, version_id, content_sha256) with duplicate identities and conflicting digests rejected.
